visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Largest Factor Is Missing
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The prime factors of 84 are 2 2 3 7, but the program prints only 2 2 3.

solution.explanation: The loop stops once p * p exceeds what is left of n. At that point the remainder (7 here) is a prime that was never divided out, so it has to be printed after the loop.
